The test image shows a tomato plant with:
- Severely wilted, brown/dried leaves throughout
- A central stem that appears bleached/tan-gray with dark spots
- Whole-plant collapse pattern
- The stem shows surface discoloration consistent with fungal stem rot

Key candidates: Sclerotinia_Timber_Rot (bleached stem, sclerotia), Phytophthora_Blight (rapid collapse, stem lesions), Southern_Blight (stem rot at soil level).

The bleached/tan stem with apparent dark spots is most consistent with Sclerotinia. Let me confirm with a reference image.

The reference image (5472861) is nearly identical to the test image (5472862) — same field setting, black plastic mulch, wire trellis, bleached/tan stem, and collapsing wilted foliage. These are sequential Bugwood images from the same disease documentation. The match is definitive.
